water.title: How much water makes sense for you?
water.body: It is a suggested goal, not a rule. Every drink counts, and you can change it whenever you like.
water.label: Daily water goal

workday.title: What are your working hours?
workday.body: Reminders only appear within these hours. Outside them, the app stays quiet.
workday.estimate: With {{hours}} of work, you will get about {{water}} water reminders and {{breaks}} break reminders a day. You can adjust this later.
workday.noDays: Choose at least one day to get reminders.

notifications.title: Want reminders as notifications?
notifications.body: That way they reach you even with HealthyWork minimized. Without it, they only appear inside the app.
notifications.note: Reminders work while the app is open, even minimized. With the app closed, they do not arrive.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. Reminders will appear inside the app.
